Commentary.Commentary: We are all set. The players are out in the middle. Aryan Dutt to bowl and Quinton de Kock and Temba Bavuma to open for the Proteas. Let's play...
...The Chase...

The bowling was excellent, to begin with by South Africa, the pacers were brilliant. They got early wickets but they'll be disappointed with their effort towards the end as they leaked far too many runs. The wicket is flat though and they would expect themselves to chase this down. Netherlands, on the other hand, will hope to take a few early wickets. Chase in a bit.

That is a very strong comeback from the Dutch and they have got to a total which can be considered competitive. They were in big trouble at one stage when they lost 5 for not a lot but Edwards played really well. He along with the lower order has taken his side to a good total. Credit to Aryan Dutt and Roelof van der Merwe too who played a handy cameo at the end.

Another loud appeal but turned down again. A yorker on middle, Edwards looks to flick it but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the off side. Two leg byes. 245 is what the Netherlands end with in this 43-overs-per-side contest.

The World Cup is moving ahead at a rapid pace and we are now into game 15. It is a clash between South Africa and Netherlands. Quite obvious who are the favourites here. South Africa have been in terrific form and should beat Netherlands who have been beaten quite easily in the tournament so far. However, in the last T20I World Cup, it was the Netherlands who beat South Africa to knock them out. Can they get another win over the Proteas? We will find out.
... MATCH DAY ...

Match number 15 of the 2023 Cricket World Cup is upon us and it will be South Africa going up against Netherlands in Dharamsala in what will be an interesting clash. The Proteas are flying high with two wins from two and they have demolished the likes of Sri Lanka and Australia already. The batting has been firing on all fronts with Quinton de Kock leading the way with two tons to start his campaign. The middle order is solid as well with Aiden Markram looking at his best and the likes of Heinrich Klaasen and David Miller in a punishing mood. The only concern is that of their skipper Temba Bavuma who has had a stellar 2023 but hasn't got going in the mega event. On the bowling front, Lungi Ngidi and Marco Jansen have been able to make the ball talk with Kagiso Rabada coming in and picking up wickets at the right time. Keshav Maharaj has shown excellent control in both matches and they have the option of playing an extra spinner in the form of Tabraiz Shamsi or choosing from a more than decent line-up of pacers on the bench. South Africa will be out for revenge given their T20 World Cup campaign in 2022 was spoiled by a heroic Dutch performance and this time, the Proteas will look to show no mercy. The Netherlands have lost both of their opening games but there have been a few positives for them in both those games. They have bowled well in patches with Aryan Dutt and Bas de Leede doing really well and the latter has been amongst the runs as well. Their openers do need to show better application and in the middle order, someone has to stay in for a big knock instead of getting 20s or 30s and then getting out. Skipper Scott Edwards needs to step up with the bat as well. If Logan van Beek does return to the side, it will certainly bolster them and with a fairly extended break after the two losses, the Dutch players can start fresh but it will be a tall order for them to get a win. That said, the win for Afghanistan against England would have certainly given them hope that nothing is impossible. Is there another upset brewing? Or will South Africa continue on their merry way?
